app.name: CaseMap
app.tagline: Organize your story and documents into one clear package.
app.description: A private space to prepare your asylum or refugee protection claim, so a legal professional can review it with you.

landing.heading: You are not the first person to do this
landing.sub: CaseMap is a community of people going through asylum and immigration — and a private place to get your own story and documents in order, before you sit down with a lawyer.
landing.what_this_is_not_title: What this tool does not do
landing.not_1: It does not decide if you qualify for protection.
landing.not_2: It does not judge whether your story is believable.
landing.not_3: It does not submit anything to the government.
landing.not_4: It does not change or delete the papers you upload.
landing.how_intro: Three steps, in whatever order suits you. Most people start by reading.
landing.step1_body: Read what people have written about hearings, documents and the long wait. Ask your own question when you have one. You do not have to write anything about yourself to begin.
landing.step2_body: When you are ready, write your story and upload the documents you have. CaseMap organizes them, builds a timeline, and shows you where a document and your account do not yet line up.
landing.step3_body: Share exactly what you choose with a verified professional, or book a consultation and bring your questions. You stay in control of the file the whole way through.
landing.cta_title: Come and read for a while
landing.cta_body: You do not have to write anything, or decide anything, or be ready. Sign in and see whether this is useful.
landing.benefits_intro: People first, then your own case, then a lawyer when you are ready.
landing.benefit_community_title: People who have already been where you are
landing.benefit_community_body: Ask what a hearing is actually like. Read what other people wish they had known. Answer someone else when you can. You post under a name you choose, never your own, and nothing you write here is connected to your case.
landing.benefit_story_title: Your story, in an order that makes sense
landing.benefit_story_body: Write what happened a section at a time, in your own words or your own language. CaseMap keeps every version, builds a timeline from the dates you give, and points out where something is unclear — without ever telling you that you are wrong.
landing.benefit_control_title: You decide who sees what, and you can change your mind
landing.benefit_control_body: Nothing is shared until you say so. You choose which parts a professional can see and for how long, and you can take that back at any moment. Booking an appointment does not share your file.
landing.benefit_lawyer_title: Time with a lawyer, when you are ready for it
landing.benefit_lawyer_body: Book a consultation with a legal professional whose licence has been checked by a person here. Bring the questions you collected along the way. The advice happens in that conversation, not on this website.
landing.privacy_title: Built for people who cannot afford a mistake
landing.privacy_intro: Everyone using this is in the middle of something where being found, or being inconsistent, carries real consequences. That shaped how it was built.
landing.privacy_1: Your community name and your case are kept apart. Nobody in the forum can see anything about your claim.
landing.privacy_2: Before you post in public, CaseMap checks your draft for phone numbers, addresses and dates that could identify you — and warns you rather than stopping you.
landing.privacy_3: A professional sees only what you granted, only while the grant lasts. Every access is recorded, and you can end it in one tap.

cards.does_body: It helps you organize your story and documents so a lawyer can review them.
cards.cannot_body: It cannot tell you if your claim will succeed. It cannot judge whether your story sounds believable. It cannot give legal advice. Only a lawyer can do those things.
cards.control_body: You choose what to share. You can correct anything. Your original documents are never changed.

orientation.checks_intro: There are no wrong answers here. This is just to make sure the tool has been clear.
orientation.q1: Can this tool tell you if your claim will be approved?
orientation.q1_correct: That's right — it cannot. Only a lawyer or a decision-maker can say what will happen with your case.
orientation.q1_wrong: Not quite. This tool cannot tell you if your claim will be approved. Only a lawyer or a decision-maker can say what will happen with your case.
orientation.q2: Can this tool decide if your story sounds believable?
orientation.q2_correct: Correct — it does not judge your story. It only helps you organize it.
orientation.q2_wrong: It does not judge your story. It only helps you organize it. A person deciding your case will look at your whole story with your lawyer.
orientation.q3: Are your original documents ever changed by this tool?
orientation.q3_correct: Right — your originals are kept exactly as you uploaded them.
orientation.q3_wrong: Your original documents are never changed. What the tool reads from them is stored separately, so the originals stay exactly as you uploaded them.

consent.heading: Your choices about how the tool works
consent.lede: You can use the whole tool without turning any of these on. You can change these choices any time.
consent.manual_note: With everything off, the tool works as a private organizer: you write, you upload, you sort — nothing is sent to any AI service.
consent.ai_processing_title: Let the tool read your writing and documents to suggest a timeline and questions
consent.ai_processing_body: When on, the tool sends your text and documents to an AI service to suggest a timeline, a list of documents, and questions for your lawyer. Every suggestion has to be checked by you and by a legal professional before it is used.
consent.machine_translation_title: Let the tool translate your writing and documents for you
consent.machine_translation_body: When on, the tool can translate what you write or upload. Machine translation is not the same as a certified translation. A lawyer or certified translator will still need to check it for anything official.
consent.prompt_title: This step needs your permission first
consent.prompt_body: This part of the tool uses an AI service. It is off by default. You can turn it on now, or keep working manually.

forum.search_intro: Someone may have asked this already.
forum.search_none_help: Try fewer words, or start a topic and ask.
forum.empty_help: Someone has to be first. It can be a question — it does not have to be a story.
forum.category_empty_help: Start the first topic in this section.
forum.no_replies: No replies yet. Yours would be the first.
forum.reply_hint: Your reply is visible to everyone in this forum.
forum.reply_failed: That reply could not be posted.
forum.new_intro: Ask something, or tell people what happened and what you learned.
forum.title_placeholder: A short summary of what this is about
forum.title_help: Someone scanning the list should be able to tell whether this is for them.
forum.body_label: What would you like to say?
forum.body_placeholder: Take as much space as you need.
forum.safety_heading: This is a public part of CaseMap. Anyone signed in can read it.
forum.safety_identifying: Leave out anything that identifies you: your full name, addresses, your village, dates of birth, case or file numbers.
forum.safety_others: The same goes for other people — someone still in danger cannot consent to being written about here.
forum.safety_case: Nothing you write here touches your case, and nothing from your case appears here.
forum.safety_private: For something you would rather tell one person, use a direct message instead.

draft_check.title: Before you post
draft_check.intro: We noticed a few things in your draft that can identify a person. Have a look — it is your choice whether to change them.
draft_check.local: This check happened on your device. Your draft is never sent anywhere to be checked.
draft_check.finding_email: This looks like an email address.
draft_check.finding_phone: This looks like a phone number.
draft_check.finding_reference_number: This looks like a case, file or reference number.
draft_check.finding_link: This is a link. Links can carry information about who followed them.
draft_check.finding_full_date: This is a full date. A date of birth or a hearing date can identify someone.

notif.title: What is waiting
notif.intro: When someone replies to you, it shows up here.
notif.none_help: When someone answers a question you asked, or joins a conversation you are in, you will see it here.
notif.prefs_in_app: Tell me in the app when someone replies to me.
notif.prefs_email: Send me one email a day if something is waiting.
notif.prefs_email_help: One message a day at most, and only when there is something unread. It names who replied and where — never anything from your case.
notif.rate_limited: You have posted a lot in a short time. Please try again shortly.
notif.prefs_messages: Tell me when someone sends me a direct message.

beta.title: Report a problem
beta.intro: You are testing an unfinished app. Anything confusing, broken, or slow is worth telling us about.
beta.notice: Six questions, about two minutes. We add the page you were on, your browser and your screen size automatically, so you do not have to.
beta.severity_blocker_hint: Work was lost, or what I was trying to do was impossible.
beta.severity_serious: It went wrong but I got through
beta.severity_serious_hint: Something behaved incorrectly, or a warning I expected never appeared.
beta.severity_cosmetic_hint: Untidy or confusing to read, but it worked.
beta.auto_captured: We also record which page you were on, your browser and your screen size. Nothing from your story or documents.
beta.filed: Sent. Thank you — you will see what we did with it below.
beta.not_a_tester_title: This is for people in the current test round.
beta.not_a_tester_body: If something is wrong, say so in the community and we will see it.

admin_beta.title: Beta reports
admin_beta.intro: What the testers have sent, and what you told them about it.
admin_beta.not_admin: This page is for platform administrators.
admin_beta.note_placeholder: What you did about it. The tester sees this.
admin_beta.triaged: Recorded. The tester can see it.
admin_beta.no_testers_help: Add testers with the service role or from your database — deliberately not self-service, because the roster is the key to the private category.
admin_beta.roster_note: A tester sees the Beta feedback category and can file reports. Ending someone's row removes both, and leaves what they wrote in place.

footer.blurb: A private space to prepare an asylum or immigration claim, and a community of people going through the same process.
footer.not_advice: CaseMap is not a law firm and does not give legal advice. Advice comes from a qualified professional, in a conversation with you.
footer.not_advice_short: CaseMap does not give legal advice.
footer.nav_signin: Sign in or create an account
footer.safety: If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services. CaseMap cannot help in an emergency, and nothing here should delay you getting help.
footer.built_for: Built for people in the middle of the process.

legal.interim_notice: These are interim documents for the testing period. CaseMap is still being built and reviewed, and this page will be replaced before the product opens to the public. It has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer.
legal.questions: Questions about anything on this page?
